Two suppliers on one gauge pair - 12.00 kg on 19 tonnes is 0.06% and comfortably inside any tolerance, and it still will not attribute. The figure belongs to neither supplier, and a small figure belongs to neither just as completely as a large one. Pro-rata allocation by volume is arithmetically neat and evidentially worthless.
